body: A coding agent for open models like Kimi K3
plain_description: The big picture: Open Interpreter gives your team an AI coding agent that runs on low-cost models, so you can accelerate development without expensive enterprise AI subscriptions. It installs in one command on any macOS, Linux, or Windows machine. The bottom line: better code, faster, at a fraction of the cost.
technical_description: Open Interpreter is a Rust-native AI coding agent, forked from OpenAI's Codex, that provides drop-in compatibility with the OpenAI Codex SDK and the Agent Client Protocol (ACP). It runs as a terminal application with a TUI interface supporting dynamic provider and model selection, multiple model-optimized harnesses (Kimi K3, DeepSeek, ZCode, and others), and native sandboxing on macOS, Linux, and Windows. The agent supports exec, MCP, skills, hooks, permissions, and AGENTS.md, and can drive web browsers via agent-browser and native apps via trycua for automated testing workflows.
title: Open Interpreter
